mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days when the rate trend is downward.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 5-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and causes negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0, or Rank IC < -0.01 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing starts (HOUST) > 2000 and industrial production (INDPRO) > 105 indicate robust consumer and business demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances when both conditions hold, or joint Rank IC < 0.01.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 200) triggers aggressive monetary policy that suppresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 200, or Rank IC < -0.02 over 5-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) reflects expanding manufacturing output that correlates with stronger corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payrolls growth below 0.5% month-over-month indicates slowing job creation that reduces consumer spending and causes negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances when PAYEMS growth < 0.5%, or Rank IC < -0.01 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent unemployment rate < 5.0% and real sales (RSAFS) > 350000 signal strong labor market and rising consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances when both conditions hold, or joint Rank IC < 0.01.

mechanism_narrative: Late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth > 2.5% annualized) with rising housing starts (HOUST) > 2000 indicates strong consumer demand that generates positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances when both conditions hold, or joint Rank IC < 0.01.
